description: Landing page polish pass — fix HowItWorks step number color progression, reduce oversized mobile numbers, widen DashboardSection, sharpen FAQ heading, fix CTA Band line break, and lift contact trust column text color.

userStories.title: Fix HowItWorks step number color progression
userStories.description: As a site visitor, I want the four process step numbers to feel like a unified visual pattern so that the section reads as a bold progression rather than a broken stepper.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove the gold-only-on-step-01 treatment where step 01 is #C9A227 and steps 02-04 are text-white/10

Replace with a consistent opacity-based progression: step 01 at full opacity (#d1e5fb or white), steps 02-04 at decreasing opacity (e.g. white/60, white/30, white/15) OR all four steps at the same muted color (#99907b or white/40)
The visual result must read as a connected numbered sequence, not a stepper UI
Hover state (group-hover:text-[#C9A227]) may be preserved or removed — whichever reads cleaner
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Current implementation: step 01 text-[#C9A227], steps 02-04 text-white/10 with hover gold. This looks like a form stepper (current step highlighted, rest greyed out) rather than a bold numbered list. The fix is to make all four numbers share the same visual language.

userStories.title: Reduce HowItWorks display number size on mobile
userStories.description: As a mobile visitor, I want the large process step numbers to be visually impactful without overwhelming the viewport width.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a responsive size breakpoint to the display number span: smaller at mobile (text-5xl or text-6xl), keeping text-8xl at md and above
The number must still be the dominant visual element in each step card on mobile
Step title and description text sizes are unchanged
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Current: text-8xl font-extrabold with no mobile override. At 375px this is ~96px — almost the full viewport width for a single character. Use text-5xl md:text-8xl or text-6xl md:text-8xl.

userStories.title: Widen DashboardSection content column
userStories.description: As a desktop visitor, I want the GBP optimization sequence to fill more of the screen so that it doesn't appear to float in empty gutters.
acceptanceCriteria: Change the GBPOptimizationSequence wrapper from max-w-2xl to max-w-4xl in components/DashboardVisual.tsx
The section heading and subhead wrapper in DashboardSection.tsx may also be widened from max-w-3xl/max-w-2xl if it improves alignment
The four step cards should still stack vertically (space-y-4) — no layout change to the cards themselves
On mobile the column remains full width (no change needed)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Current: max-w-2xl mx-auto in GBPOptimizationSequence root div. At 1440px this creates ~500px of empty space on each side. Widening to max-w-4xl (896px) keeps it readable while filling the section better.

userStories.title: Replace FAQ section heading with punchier copy
userStories.description: As a site visitor, I want the FAQ section heading to be as direct and confident as the other headings on the page.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace the current FAQ heading 'Things Worth Asking Before You Hire Anyone' with a shorter, more direct heading
Recommended replacement: 'Questions We Get Every Time' or 'What People Ask Before They Book' — choose whichever fits the brand voice (direct, confident, no fluff)
The heading className (font-display font-extrabold text-[#d1e5fb] tracking-tight) is unchanged
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Current heading is 8 words and reads like a listicle subheading. Compare to other page headings: 'Your Competitors Rank Higher. That's Fixable.' — confident and short. The FAQ heading should match that energy.

userStories.title: Fix CTA Band heading line break
userStories.description: As a site visitor, I want the CTA Band headline to break cleanly across lines without creating a short orphaned word on the last line.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a max-w constraint to the CTA Band heading (e.g. max-w-xl or max-w-2xl) so the text wraps at a natural point
The heading 'Start with a free audit call. No pitch, no pressure.' should break after 'call.' leaving 'No pitch, no pressure.' on its own line — or wrap earlier if the viewport is narrow
Do not change the copy or the italic/font treatment on 'free'
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: The orphan happens because the heading has no max-w and stretches to fill the section width. A max-w-xl or max-w-2xl centered on the heading element will force a clean break.

userStories.title: Lift contact page trust column text to primary color
userStories.description: As a site visitor on the contact page, I want the 'What We Cover on the Call' bullet points to read as selling points rather than fine print.
acceptanceCriteria: In app/contact/page.tsx, change the trust column bullet text color from text-[#99907b] (muted) to text-[#d1e5fb] (primary light)
The bullet icon color (text-[#C9A227]) remains unchanged
The section label ('What We Cover on the Call') color remains unchanged
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Current: bullet text uses text-[#99907b] which is the muted/secondary color used for supporting copy. These bullets are persuasive selling points (Your GBP and local search pages, AI search visibility, etc.) and should use the primary text color to match their importance.
